reviews.title: Great - I use it Everyday.
reviews.text:
Updated - All I wanted was a “Skin” lock feature! Then… all I see is more and more skins added!! Why? Those are not for loyal users. We find the one we love and use it. But every time I touch my iPhone to move it, the skin changes. That’s so annoying!

I took it from my 5-stars to 3 until they fix this feature.  Add a Lock-skin button so the face doesn’t change until we go back into settings. 

I have the Pro version. I’m always on calls or on a Zoom meeting… this is a great tool to keep me on time. It would get 5-Stars if they can add a feature to lock the skin. The skins change every time I touch the phone.  Add that - and this is a 5-Star review

reviews.title: FIVE YEARS WITH THIS APP
reviews.text:
When you find your desired Clock Face and turn it on, it’s a nice way to tell time. I use it in my car all the time.  I use it on my previous iPhone by my bed at night. You can adjust the brightness using the normal iPad brightness settings. There are quite a few faces from which to choose. 
One ‘feature’ I don’t like, which is very annoying, is that it drops out of clock mode and into the setup screen quite often for no apparent reason. Sometimes it just changes the clock screen on its own and you have to go back in change it to the one you like. If it weren’t for those annoyances, I’d give it a five star, but the developers thought that being a little bothersome is a good marketing tactic. I disagree.  
Anyway, the good outweighs the bad given its affordability, and I would recommend it to anyone who needs to have a clock to look at.

reviews.title: Life changing
reviews.text: All my life I have wondered, what is the time of day right now? I've always been late or early to appointments, school, and work, and found it difficult to maintain relationships simply due to my not knowing the time. But now I have this app, and whenever I need to know the time I can simply open this app and the current time of day is displayed by two pointers on a round dial. It's nothing short of miraculous.
